shipLog.text: ◆ At each stop, STOP opens the Stop menu: the things you can do here. Each verb costs time and the crew's effort, which costs morale. RESUME flies on to the next stop.
◆ Crop planted. MARV has opened a file for it. He opens a file for everything that might end. It is a large cabinet.
Arrived: Asteroid Field 1. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
The Sponsor. The captain chose “Decline. Politely”. Noted.
You decline. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Materials aboard. The FABRICATOR (Stop menu) turns them into hull patches, repair kits and the rest; a print takes days and adds wear. A station's FAB SERVICE resets the wear.
Arrived: Colony Vessel 7 (Registry Pending). The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, −5 CROP, +2 MORALE, 8 DAYS. Filed.
Also: −1 O2.
◆ The ship computer notes that more events have been logged about the tomatoes than about the hull. It does not editorialize. (−5 crop health)
◆ CHIP files a reference next to the Provident's registry entry: ships built to carry whole generations are a real, seriously-studied idea.
The Other Colony Ship. The captain chose “Hail them — friendly, mostly”. Noted.
You open a channel and spend an hour trading route notes, complaints… +3 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ INV opens the hold. Each item says what it does and which events it can open. USE it from there, SELL it when docked, or JETTISON it to free a slot.
Arrived: Outpost Remember-To-Buy-Fuel. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
1 DAY. It will not last.
Station Inbound. The captain chose “LEAVE STATION”. Noted.
Nothing aboard changed. It will not last.
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Docked. The dock has rooms to visit and the Market Row. From the Stop menu: MEDBAY heals everyone, DRYDOCK patches the hull, FAB SERVICE resets the fabricator. Waving off closes all of them.
Tomato: VEGETATIVE. 26% grown, health 83. Temporarily.
Arrived: Route Decision. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
Both Lanes Watched. The captain chose “Run the storm: starboard lane”. Noted.
You take the storm. −10 HULL, −2 MORALE, 1 DAY. As calculated.
◆ The readout strip opens Orders: pace trades speed for fuel and morale, rations trade food for morale, and the water split shares water between the crew and the crop.
Arrived: Depot Kowalski. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ A tomato has fallen off the vine. Three crew members have opinions about this. (−2 morale)
The Long Dark Bar. The captain chose “BACK TO THE BAR”. Noted.
You leave the engineer to the rest of their beer. +1 MORALE, −5 GOLD, 2 DAYS. It will not last.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
1 DAY. It will not last.
Station Inbound. The captain chose “LEAVE STATION”. Noted.
Nothing aboard changed. It will not last.
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ The crop card opens the growbay: its health, its water, its threats, who tends it, TREAT for pests, and the harvest.

identity.name: Old Marrow
identity.story: They were a seed-bank keeper on a station that decommissioned around them. They heard — through the janitors' network, naturally — that a ship was hauling a live crop to a new world, and could not bear not to be near it. They have been secretly adjusting your growbay's nutrient mix for two weeks. The crop's recent good week was not luck.
identity.line: The zinnias needed magnesium. Everything needs magnesium eventually. So. Am I staying?
identity.join_note: A second green thumb. If a botanist is already aboard, the two of them will disagree about magnesium forever.
